video.title: FULLTANK SATURDAY: Are You Living Your Life—or Someone Else’s?
video.description:
Allowing other people's expectations, judgments, or approval to run your life is a miserable way to live. When you anchor your heart in God's perfect love, you are freed from fear, empowered to make brave choices, and able to live the authentic calling He has for you. 

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #AreYouLivingYourLife #Mark6 #ChooseLoveOverFear #FreedomInChrist #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #AuthenticLiving #Grace

---
PS. Are You A Parent?
Are you thinking about Homeschooling for your kids?
My wife and I have homeschooled our two boys.
Looking back, it’s one of the BEST decisions we’ve ever made.
It gave us the space to pass on our values.
It also gave them space to explore their passions and interests.
If you want to know more about homeschooling and to find out if it is for your kids, check out this link: www.facebook.com/CFAHomeschool or cfa.edu.ph

comments.author: @sachi2911
comments.text: I have already taken my first step to released myself from fear. I hid after I resigned from my corpo job to choose being a mom to my toddler. I didn't pose anything on my social media account until one day, I decided to go out with a lot of courage and strength I kept in my heart after many prayers because I'm afraid what others will say after they will see my updates. I posted my life update for my business even when I'm not prepared and fully strong to face the viewer's reaction but I was happy when many people chatted with me and asked me how I am, where I am, and where your place is because it looks beautiful and peaceful. That time, I got answered prayer. Many people are not at peace right now and they need someone to remind them about it. I still don't know where this journey with God will take me but I have now the right relationship with Him. I hope everyone who's reading this will find courage also to take their first step in conquering the fears inside their hearts. God bless us all. 🙏
